_what: The parity backlog as a DAG. `needs` names tasks that must be done first; a task with
unmet dependencies is BLOCKED and the loop will not offer it. Specialists mirror the
roles the orchestration pattern assigns: rendering, moveset, engine, pipeline.
GOAL: mechanical parity with Tekken and Schwarzerblitz in how a match actually plays.

tasks.title: The thigh still collapses on full-body clips
tasks.measure: tools/model_diag/lbs_in_play.mjs --masked must hold median >= 0.85 (gated); the unmasked figure is the open one
tasks.now: 0.92 with the legs held at the stance (a hand strike), 0.65 median when a full-body clip drives them, as low as 0.25
tasks.notes: THE DIAGNOSIS CHANGED, measured. Holding the legs at the stance takes ALTERNATINGFOREARMS from 0.23 to 0.92 and 0 of 60 clips pinch below 0.85, where 40 did. DQS on the same clips only reaches 0.42 on that one, so the shader would have been the expensive fix for a DATA problem — the collapse was overwhelmingly corrupt leg tracks, not linear blend skinning. WHAT IS LEFT splits in two, and only the second wants a shader: (1) full-body clips whose legs are ALSO corrupt and therefore cannot be masked because the legs ARE the move — APRONJAYKICK leaves the pelvis 92 deg out, CORKSCREW_KIP_UP peaks at 1007 deg/s; those need the rest-offset fix. (2) clips that are genuinely credible AND genuinely extreme — BREAKDANCE_FREEZES 0.41, CAPOEIRA 0.25 with a clean pelvis and 479/623 deg/s. That is real LBS loss and DQS roughly doubles it (0.25 -> 0.48) without fixing it. References if it comes to that: KosRud/DQ-skinning-for-Unity (HLSL), ishmeetkohli/dualQuaternionSkinning (GLSL).

tasks.title: Clips with impossible legs no longer own them
tasks.measure: tools/model_diag/stance_gap.mjs — world-space leg direction against the stance, not bind
tasks.now: the 81-degree target was retired as a bad proxy; 190 non-credible clips now borrow the stance
tasks.notes: Measured in world space the idles sit 0-17 degrees from the stance and are correct; ALTERNATINGFOREARMS is 90-129 and CHOKESLAM 91-142, the same clips the credibility audit names. There is no global retarget offset. upf-gti/retargeting-threejs is in tools/reference as the basis for the next re-rig (BindPoseModes.CURRENT).

tasks.title: Upper-body moves must not drive the legs
tasks.measure: tools/parity/pelvis_gate.ts — a hand strike must stay within 15 deg of the idle stance envelope, with the same clip played as a kick as the control
tasks.now: 7.2 deg masked vs 94.6 deg unmasked. src/engine/motion/BoneMask.ts, 13 tests, gated in the critic.
tasks.notes: Was blocked on rest-offset on the theory that the offset had to be removed from the clips first. It does not: the engine can decline to read the part of the clip that is wrong. The mask comes from the motion state, never from measuring the corrupt tracks. Kicks, jumps, throws, hits, knockdowns and taunts keep their own legs; crouching strikes borrow the LIVE crouch stance, which is better than the crouch their capture happened to contain.
